question: For an F-2-3 spouse of a permanent resident visa at an embassy (Case 1), whose criminal records and health check-up results are required, and who must issue the health check-up?
reference: Criminal records of both spouses, issued by the responsible authority of each country, and health check-up results for the married couple. question: Which foreign doctors are eligible for an E-5 professional visa through Confirmation of Visa Issuance, and at which kinds of institutions may they work?
reference: A doctor holding a foreign licence acknowledged by Korean law, recommended by the Minister of Health and Welfare, with advanced knowledge of the latest medical technology, who will work at a medical institution run by the government or a local government, a medical corporation, or a medical institution run by a non-profit corporation or a government-invested corporation. A graduate of a Korean medical or dental school who will do an internship or residency at a university-affiliated hospital or a hospital designated by the Minister of Health and Welfare is also eligible.
answer: Foreign doctors eligible for an E-5 professional visa through Confirmation of Visa Issuance are those who obtain a foreign license acknowledged by Korean laws and allowed to practice in the Republic of Korea [1]. They must be recommended by the Minister of Health and Welfare of ROK, have advanced knowledge in the latest medical technology, and plan to work at specific organizations [1]. These institutions include a medical institution run by Government or Local government, a medical corporation, or a medical institution run by a non-profit corporation or a government invested corporation [1]. A person who plans to take an internship or residency program at a university-affiliated hospital or a hospital designated by the Minister of Health and Welfare of ROK after graduation from a medical or dental school in ROK is also eligible, though this category applies to graduates rather than those with existing foreign licenses [1].
